text: この　こううんを　きねんして　とっときの　わざ　タマゴうみを　おしえよう！

structure.jp: この　こううんを　きねんして
とっときの　わざ　タマゴうみを

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The よう ending on a verb says the speaker has decided to do it, like 'I'll' or 'let me'. おしえよう = 'I'll teach you'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this action to the next one, here giving the occasion for it. こううんを きねんして = 'commemorating this good fortune'.
